public_rationale: Contemporary public skepticism is documented, particularly about investment returns. The reviewed evidence does not show increasing recognition of all five specific limitations. Survey optimism also prevents treating selected critical commentary as a complete account of public opinion, though it does not contradict growing awareness of particular weaknesses.
limitations: The population and size of the claimed change are unspecified.
A loose reading meaning only that some prominent people voiced doubts would be easier to support.
The survey sample is not representative of all people and does not test the full claim.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: People are starting to realize generative AI has plateaued, lacks a killer app, still hallucinates and errs, and has no moat.

statement.excerpt: People are starting to realize all of the above.
statement.document_title: AlphaProof, AlphaGeometry, ChatGPT, and why the future of AI is neurosymbolic

from_speaker: People are starting to realize all of the above.
The current approach has reached a plateau
our_interpretation: The plain reading is an emerging increase in public recognition of the five listed limitations, not merely the existence of some critics.
Recognition means expressed belief in those limitations; this claim does not itself establish that the beliefs are correct.
The surrounding comparison with less than a year earlier supplies a lookback window of July 28, 2023 through July 28, 2024.
No majority threshold is imposed, but 'all of the above' requires evidence covering the full list. Comparable surveys or a systematic body of dated commentary could show the trend.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable opinion evidence or systematic contemporary commentary demonstrates increasing recognition of all five listed limitations by the post date.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence covering the same population and propositions demonstrates that recognition was stable or declining, contrary to the claimed emerging increase.

evidence.explanation: The January survey disclosure reports substantial optimism among 1,000 college-educated, informed US consumers. This limits any inference of uniform disillusionment, but optimism can coexist with awareness of errors; the disclosure does not supply fieldwork dates or a matching trend measure.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable surveys or a systematic analysis of dated public commentary showing whether recognition of each listed limitation increased during the target period.
